title: Magnetic field direction
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the magnetic field is perpendicular to the inclined plane and points upward.

title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the magnetic induction B as 1.2 T using the equilibrium condition BIL = mg sin θ.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply Newton's first law, balancing the component of gravity down the incline with the magnetic force for part (1).

title: Modified equilibrium setup
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the response must set up the correct force balance: F + BIL cos θ = mg sin θ, accounting for the new magnetic force component.

title: External force magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the external force F as 0.24 N from the part (2) equilibrium equation.

title: External force direction
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the external force F acts upward along the rail to maintain equilibrium in part (2).

title: Correct use of trigonometry
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly use sin 37° and cos 37° to resolve weight and magnetic force components along the incline.

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly adds or subtracts the magnetic force term in the part (2) equilibrium equation, leading to a wrong F.

title: Unit omission or error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if final answers for B or F are given without correct units (T, N) or with incorrect unit conversions.
